construction.statement: The Rust ep-cleanroom-verifier file runner implements EP-CONFORMANCE-FILE-RUNNER-v3. It reads an execution suite of opaque handles and returns computed results. It does not receive catalogue ids, expect objects, or currency expect_status. It was implemented from the public EMILIA drafts, the v3 protocol, and the pinned vector bundle at emilia-protocol 9f059f49e4ded8e1390df7b0e08b2127c40c74e3. packages/verify and the one-team JavaScript, Python, and Go ports were not used as implementation guides. The runner artifact is the release binary from cargo build --bin conformance --release with rustc 1.99.0 (b940084d7 2026-09-28) for x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu. keys/public.key in the Rust tree is the construction-statement key. This file-runner submission is not signed by that key.
